title: Engineering Design Process Fundamentals
centralClaim: The engineering design process is a structured, iterative approach to problem solving involving collaboration and decision-making.
whyItMatters: Provides the foundational understanding for all subsequent engineering activities; enables effective project management and team coordination.

contributors.name: Engineering Design Process
contributors.reason: Represents the core concept of structured design methodologies.

objections: Can be overly rigid and stifle creativity.
May not be suitable for all types of projects (e.g., exploratory research).
Requires significant upfront planning and documentation.
Risk of analysis paralysis if stages are overemphasized.
